data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue
data.body:
Hi,

Caldwell Sutter Capital's most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in AXR and PLBC.

AXR reported Q2 2026 revenue of $6.1M versus $17.9M a year earlier, down 66.1% year over year (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/6207/000110465926107084/0001104659-26-107084-index.htm).

I publish Local Ledger, an independent research service based on public records, never issuer-paid. May I send the free weekly issue and details on a four-week fund pilot?

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
